reasoning_content:
No node processes are listening. The dev server processes exited after building. This suggests that the Angular dev server exits when stdin is closed (</dev/null) or when detached with setsid. Let me check.

Actually looking at app.log: "NX Successfully ran target serve for project app" - that means the serve command completed/exited. But boards.log shows "Watch mode enabled. Watching for file changes..." which means it should still be running. Yet no listening port.

Hmm. Maybe the dev server processes died when the sandbox lost connection? Actually the setsid should detach them. Let me look more carefully.

Wait, the issue: the dev servers were started with `nohup setsid ... < /dev/null`. When the terminal/sandbox crashed, perhaps processes got killed. But boards just finished building at 19:11:58.

Let me check if processes are still alive.

action.command: ps aux | grep -E 'set-exit-as-crashed|@angular|vite|dev-server|run-executor' | grep -v grep | head; echo "---"; ps aux | grep -c 'nx serve'

tool_call.name: terminal
